page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.6xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is built on the x86_64 architecture and allocates 24 dedicated vCPUs along with 192 GB of system memory. This resource profile establishes an 8 GB memory allocation per vCPU, specifically targeting applications requiring large working sets in main memory.

The instance does not bundle local ephemeral storage, meaning operating system disks and persistent data must be mounted using external block storage services. Baseline network throughput is rated at 8 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included. Hardware acceleration is not present, with zero dedicated GPUs assigned to the configuration. System resource overhead remains concentrated on sustained CPU allocation and memory capacity rather than specialized compute engines or integrated NVMe storage.

Cost efficiency for the ecs.r6.6xlarge is characterized by its high memory-to-core density, reducing the need to overprovision compute cores merely to acquire necessary RAM capacity. Workloads best suited for this instance include distributed in-memory caching solutions like Redis and Memcached, high-throughput relational databases, in-memory analytics systems, enterprise ERP deployments, and large-scale data transformation pipelines.
